summary: Blocked: this commit corrects tests that exercised maximal-clique algorithms on unsupported asymmetric directed graphs. It filters QuickCheck inputs to retain only reciprocal edges, updates unit tests, and documents the symmetry requirement. The algorithm implementation is unchanged; src/algo/maximal_cliques.rs changes only documentation. Reintroducing the reported problem would require reversing test changes, violating the requirement to preserve upstream tests. No valid implementation reversal or detecting test can be selected.
